Title: Public preview: Application Gateway IPv6 support

Body.Content:
Azure Application Gateway v2 now supports dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6)  connections at the front end. This means that Application Gateway can handle traffic from both IPv4 and IPv6 clients, offering more flexibility and connectivity to our users. Whether you are facing IPv4 address exhaustion or need to comply with various regulatory requirements from government agencies, you can now benefit from IPv6 addressing by creating a new Application Gateway that uses both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. This feature is part of our ongoing commitment to provide the best possible service and experience to our customers. We hope you enjoy using it and we welcome your feedback.

Learn more about IPv6 support on Application Gateway

 

.
